✨ Speed-Test | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a simple, lightweight, and secure way to measure network performance directly from a web browser without requiring any client-side software or plugins.
✨ Key Features: • Free and Open-Source • HTML5 Network Performance Estimation Tool • Written in Vanilla JavaScript • Uses only built-in Web APIs (XMLHttpRequest, HTML, CSS, JS, SVG) • No Third-Party frameworks or libraries required
📖 Summary: SpeedTest by OpenSpeedTest™ is a free, open-source HTML5 tool for estimating network performance. Written in vanilla JavaScript, it uses only built-in web APIs and requires no third-party frameworks, making it lightweight and secure. It can be hosted on any static web server.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 QtScrcpy | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Mirroring and controlling an Android device's screen on a computer for enhanced productivity, gaming, or presentation purposes.
✨ Key Features: • Display and control Android devices • USB or network connection • No root required • Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux) • Lightweight and high performance (30-60 fps)
📖 Summary: QtScrcpy is a lightweight and high-performance application that allows users to display and control their Android devices on their computers via USB or network connection. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, requires no root access, and focuses on low latency and fast startup times.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 weathr | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Displaying real-time weather information with animated ASCII art in a terminal environment.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time weather data from Open-Meteo • ASCII animations (rain, snow, thunderstorms, day/night cycles) • Auto-location detection • Customizable configuration (hide HUD, silent mode, location display) • Multiple installation methods (binary, Cargo, Docker, Homebrew, MacPorts, AUR, Nix, Winget)
📖 Summary: Weathr is a terminal-based weather application written in Rust that displays real-time weather information with engaging ASCII animations. It features auto-location detection and customizable display options, providing a visually rich weather experience directly in the command line.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 Mockoops | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating animated mockups from screen recordings for presentations, teasers, and product announcements.
✨ Key Features: • Superfast rendering powered by Serverless Functions • Real-time preview updates • Responsive Video Templates • Multiple pre-built templates • Long-term Caching
📖 Summary: Mockoops is a JavaScript-based tool that transforms boring screen recordings into beautiful, animated mockups in seconds. It leverages React and serverless functions for fast rendering, offering responsive video templates and long-term caching.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
